# Vendored remotes

| Directory | Remote | Install |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lovecloudsjl-github` | https://github.com/lovecloudsjl/.github.git | `bash scripts/install-lovecloudsjl-github.sh` |

`lovecloudsjl/.github` is a GitHub special repository (root README plus `profile/README.md`). There is no package to compile. The install script connects the remote — or keeps the API snapshot when the Cloud Agent git identity cannot clone it.
